# jsPsych runtime

`jspsych-8.3.0.min.js` is the jsPsych 8.3.0 published browser bundle, obtained from
https://unpkg.com/jspsych@8.3.0/dist/index.browser.min.js. Upstream source:
https://github.com/jspsych/jsPsych. Its MIT license is in `LICENSE.jspsych` (upstream
`license.txt`). The optional remote source-map reference was removed; no runtime
CDN is required. No plugins, analytics, hosted collection, or external fonts are
loaded. Experiment-specific screens use a small custom jsPsych plugin.
